intended_object: The unit 1 + εr of the dual numbers R[ε] (ε² = 0), with inverse 1 − εr. Inferred from the docstring and from its use in building the isomorphism between the additive group of R and the units of R[ε] that reduce to 1 modulo ε.
explanation: The value is the pair (1, r), i.e. 1 + εr, with inverse (1, −r), i.e. 1 − εr. The inverse proofs check the dual-number products: first component 1·1 = 1, second component 1·(−r) + r·1 = 0 (and 1·r + (−r)·1 = 0 in the other order). This is exactly the intended unit. The companion lemmas liftUnit_fst/liftUnit_snd confirm the components, and liftUnit_add gives (1 + εr)(1 + εs) = 1 + ε(r + s). It is a specific element of a specific ring, so it is not too narrow for being specific. The section's CommRing assumption is stronger than this definition needs (a ring would do), but it is the setting of the whole file (matrix kernels, where determinants need commutativity), so it is not a real narrowing. Mathlib has general facts about when elements of TrivSqZeroExt are units, but no declaration packaging 1 + εr as a unit.
